tables_enriched.name: customers
tables_enriched.description: Stores information about customers, including personal contact details, account status, type, and region, along with timestamps for when the customer record was created.

tables_enriched.name: Orders
tables_enriched.description: Stores core information about customer orders, including identifiers, dates, statuses, financial amounts (order, total, shipping, tax), payment details, timestamps, and notes.

tables_enriched.name: order_items
tables_enriched.description: Stores details of items within orders, including the product, quantity, pricing, discounts, and calculated line totals for each order item.

tables_enriched.name: products
tables_enriched.description: Stores product catalog data including identifiers, names, SKUs, categories, pricing, stock levels, activation status, and descriptive text for each product.

tables_enriched.name: payments
tables_enriched.description: Stores payment records including identifiers, amounts, methods, statuses, and associated transaction details for customer orders.
